slides.title: UN releases emergency aid for northern Ethiopia

slides.body: Additional money from the UN Central Emergency Response Fund, announced by UN aid chief Tom Fletcher.
People the funds are expected to reach: those newly or repeatedly displaced, or cut off from basic services.

slides.title: Four regions affected
slides.body: Tigray, Amhara, Afar and Benishangul-Gumuz, where fighting has displaced civilians and disrupted relief, Capital reported.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Allow safe, unhindered aid access.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Capital Ethiopia, "UN allocates $8.5 million emergency fund for northern Ethiopia..." · Oct 14, 2026
